name: CA Certificates
description: Installs CA certificates from URLs or local file paths into the system trust store and runs the OS-specific update command

urls.description: Comma-separated list of URLs or absolute local file paths pointing to CA certificates (PEM/CRT format) to install

ignoreMissing.description: When true, skip certificates that cannot be downloaded or found instead of failing the installation

searchCerts.description: When true, treat each entry in 'urls' that is a local directory as a directory to scan for certificate files (*.crt, *.pem) and install all found certificates
